top_signals.title: Stocks Hit Records on AI Trade, Iran Deal Prospect: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Global stocks climbed to a record as hopes rose for a US-Iran deal to open the Strait Of Hormuz, while investors renewed bets on the artificial intelligence trade, driving gains in chipmakers.
